title: Equivalent forward dependency closure and transposed reverse resolution
explanation: This is a query-equivalence-under-dependencies problem, the setting of the relational chase: program C1 computes ForwardReach, the transitive closure of a forward step relation (direct ForwardEdge pairs, plus pairs backed by a valid bridge proof) starting from ForwardSeed; program C2 computes ResolvedPair, the same kind of closure computed instead over the transposed backward relations (BackwardSeed, BackwardEdge) with its own reverse step relation. The precondition's six tuple-generating dependencies (two of them existential) say the forward and backward seed relations are transposes of each other, that ForwardEdge equals the pairs backed by a valid bridge proof, and that BackwardEdge equals the transpose of that same relation; under those dependencies the postcondition claims the two closures agree, ForwardReach = ResolvedPair.
preInWords: PRE says ForwardSeed and BackwardSeed are transposes of each other, ForwardEdge equals the pairs backed by a valid bridge proof, and BackwardEdge equals the transpose of that same bridge-proof relation.
postInWords: POST says the forward-computed reachability relation ForwardReach equals the reverse-computed relation ResolvedPair.
family: two programs under TGD constraints (LLM-generated, GPT-5.6; legacy raw_new pipeline)
precondition: ((ForwardSeed ⊆ π[1,0] (BackwardSeed)) ∧ ((BackwardSeed ⊆ π[1,0] (ForwardSeed)) ∧ ((ForwardEdge ⊆ π[0,1] (σ[#2 = #3] ((BridgeProof × ValidBridge)))) ∧ ((π[0,1] (σ[#2 = #3] ((BridgeProof × ValidBridge))) ⊆ ForwardEdge) ∧ ((π[0,1] (σ[#2 = #3] ((BridgeProof × ValidBridge))) ⊆ π[1,0] (BackwardEdge)) ∧ (BackwardEdge ⊆ π[1,0] (σ[#2 = #3] ((BridgeProof × ValidBridge)))))))))

datalog.label: prog_c1
datalog.text:
ForwardReach(x1, y1) :- ForwardSeed(x1, y1).
ForwardStep(x1, y1) :- ForwardEdge(x1, y1).
ForwardReach(x1, z1) :- ForwardReach(x1, y1), ForwardStep(y1, z1).
ForwardStep(x1, z1) :- ForwardReach(x1, y1), BridgeProof(y1, z1, x2), ValidBridge(x2).
ForwardReach(x1, z1) :- ForwardStep(x1, y1), ForwardReach(y1, z1).

datalog.label: prog_c2
datalog.text:
ResolvedPair(x1, y1) :- BackwardSeed(y1, x1).
ReverseStep(y1, x1) :- BackwardEdge(y1, x1).
ResolvedPair(x1, z1) :- ResolvedPair(x1, y1), ReverseStep(z1, y1).
ReverseStep(z1, x1) :- ResolvedPair(x1, y1), BridgeProof(y1, z1, x2), ValidBridge(x2).
ResolvedPair(x1, z1) :- ReverseStep(y1, x1), ResolvedPair(y1, z1).
